name: openmouse
description: Visual mouse and computer-use tools for the Windows desktop, local Chromium, and an embedded cloud browser.

interface.shortDescription: Visual mouse control for desktop and cloud browsers
interface.longDescription: Observe screens, operate the real Windows mouse and taskbar, control local Chromium pages, and run an isolated Playwright browser in the cloud through one MCP interface.
defaultPrompt: Use OpenMouse to observe my screen and operate the requested desktop or browser target.
